anomalies.impact: C1 is 10x too small (and rated 16 V instead of 25 V) for the EPD boost-converter input rail. The reduced bulk capacitance on the switched Display_Power_Switch node can starve the boost converter (L1/Q1) of input charge during the high-current EPD refresh pulses, causing rail droop, unstable boost regulation and possible display artifacts; the lower voltage rating also erodes margin on a node that sees boost-converter transients.
